Integrations/Recruiting & HR

Zoho Recruit

Zoho Recruit is an applicant tracking and recruitment platform for managing candidates, job openings, interviews, applications, and hiring workflows.

62 actionsSign in with Zoho Recruit

Connect Zoho Recruit

What your bot can do in Zoho Recruit

Looks up

  • Download AttachmentDownload a file attachment from a Zoho Recruit record.
  • Download PhotoDownload the photo for one Zoho Recruit Candidate or Contact.
  • Get Application Pipeline TransitionsGet stage-grouped hiring-pipeline transitions for one Zoho Recruit application.
  • Get Custom ViewsList a Zoho Recruit module's custom views or return one custom view with its criteria, sharing details, and selected fields.
  • Get Module MetadataGet one Zoho Recruit module's capabilities, layouts, attachment categories, custom views, and related-list metadata.
  • Get OrganizationReturn identity, locale, currency, company, and license details for the connected Zoho Recruit organization.
  • Get ProfilesList Zoho Recruit permission profiles or return one profile with detailed permissions by ID.
  • Get RecordGet one Zoho Recruit record, including subform details, by module and record ID.
  • Get RolesList all Recruit organization roles or return one role by ID.
  • Get Tag Record CountGet the number of Zoho Recruit records using a tag and optionally return the areas where the tag is configured.
Show 15 more
  • List Associated RecordsList one page of job openings associated with a candidate or candidates associated with a job opening.
  • List AttachmentsList attachments and linked URLs on one Zoho Recruit record.
  • List Deleted RecordsReturn one provider page of recycle-bin or permanently deleted records from a Zoho Recruit module.
  • List FieldsList field API names and metadata for a Zoho Recruit module across layouts.
  • List Hiring Pipeline HistoryReturn one page of hiring-pipeline history for a Candidate, Application, or Job Opening.
  • List ModulesList modules available to the connected user with their API names, access profiles, display fields, and supported operations.
  • List Note TypesReturn one page of configured Zoho Recruit note types.
  • List NotesReturn one page of Zoho Recruit notes.
  • List RecordsReturn one page of records from a supported Zoho Recruit module.
  • List Related ListsDiscover related-list API names and route templates available for a Zoho Recruit module.
  • List Related RecordsReturn one page from a named related list such as Notes, Attachments, Interviews, Contacts, or Reviews.
  • List StagesReturn one page of Zoho Recruit hiring stages and the statuses mapped to each stage.
  • List TagsList tags configured for a Recruit module, including counts and the module's allowed tag count.
  • List UsersList Recruit users by status group or return the connected current user.
  • Search RecordsSearch one Zoho Recruit module using exactly one selector and return one provider page of up to 49 matching records.

Takes action

  • Add Tags To RecordsAdd existing tags by name to one or up to 500 records in a Zoho Recruit module.
  • Associate Candidates With JobsAssociate candidate IDs with job-opening IDs and optionally add a comment.
  • Cancel InterviewCancel one scheduled Zoho Recruit interview with an optional reason and feedback.
  • Change Job Opening PipelineAssign a different hiring pipeline to one Zoho Recruit job opening and choose whether to migrate its existing stage history.
  • Change Offer StatusChange one Zoho Recruit Offer record's status.
  • Change Record StatusChange Candidate, Application, or Job Opening status for one or more record IDs.
  • Create AssessmentsCreate one or more Zoho Recruit assessment definitions, including optional sections and questions, through the v2.1 Assessments API.
  • Create NotesCreate one or more notes attached to Zoho Recruit records.
  • Create PipelineCreate one organization-wide Job Openings hiring pipeline from existing stage and status IDs.
  • Create RecordsCreate up to 100 records in a supported Zoho Recruit module.
